name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools
description: Dev-time minimal functional stand-in for @mstar-harness/dsh. The real package is private (not on the npm registry) and ships from the host dsh app at runtime; this stub provides the consumed type surface (defineTool / DefineToolOptions / ParameterSchemaSpec / ValueSchemaSpec / generic presentCall-presentResult cards + the tools/pre-execute event) and just enough runtime for real-composition tests (schema compilation + validation, defineTool wrapping with soft presenters, ctx.tools registry with register/lookup/execute). Mirrors dsh-private commit 9451be2 (2026-08-07 snapshot).
